breakdown.description: Otto cycle is defined incorrectly (Otto has constant-volume heat addition, not constant-pressure).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still states 'Otto cycle with constant-pressure heat addition,' repeating the original error. The ground truth clarifies that Otto has constant-volume heat addition and constant-pressure heat addition corresponds to a Diesel cycle.

breakdown.description: Efficiency formula is applied for a different cycle than described.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification applies η = 1 - 1/r^(γ-1) to a process described as having constant-pressure heat addition. This formula is for the Otto cycle (constant-volume heat addition). For constant-pressure heat addition (Diesel cycle), the Diesel efficiency formula should be used. The mismatch was not corrected.
